'''''Tatooine Travel Advertisement''''' was the name of an advertising [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The poster was meant to lure travelers to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. The advertisement depicted a [[City/Legends|city]] on the planet, with several domed buildings and [[Sentience/Legends|people]] walking through the streets. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text, the [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], at the top of the poster read "Tatooine."

==Description==
The [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] advertisement depicted a typical [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with several domed buildings, some with tall spires. Several [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were barely visible in the sky, and a few [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] could be seen bustling through the sandy, dusty streets. Text in the upper-left corner of the poster, written in the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], read "Tatooine."<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
''Tatooine Travel Advertisement'' was an advertising [[Painting/Legends|poster]] that was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a crucial engagement in the conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] known as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The purpose of the poster was to convince travelers and tourists to visit [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Tatooine Travel Advertisement'' was a decorative item in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which was released to the public on [[June 26]], [[2003]].<ref name="SWG" /> The game shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players could obtain the poster as a [[W:c:swg:Loot card|loot item]] from the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' expansion set ''[[Agents of Deception]]''. [[Ord Mantell Travel Advertisement|Several]] [[Mustafar Travel Advertisement|other]] [[Hoth Travel Advertisement|similarly]] themed advertisement posters were available through the trading card game.<ref name="SWGTCG:HTA">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Hoth Travel Advertisement|swglink=Hoth-Travel-Advertisement-card.jpg}}</ref><ref name="SWGTCG:MTA">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Mustafar Travel Advertisement|swglink=Mustafar Travel.JPG}}</ref><ref name="SWGTCG:OMTA">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Ord Mantell Travel Advertisement|swglink=Ord Mantell Travel Advertisement.jpg}}</ref> Once obtained, the player could use the poster as decoration in a personal structure.<ref name="SWG" />
